brief_data.the_case_p1: Emerald AI raised a $150M oversubscribed Series A on 25 Aug 2026, valuing the grid-flexibility software company at $1.05B and lifting total capital raised past $220M. Energize Capital and DCVC co-led the round, joined by NVIDIA, Siemens, GE Vernova, RWE, Aramco Ventures and Samsung Ventures — twelve Fortune Global 500 companies now hold equity. The raise marks a <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>BRAND RECKONING</font> moment: Emerald moves from demonstration pilots to multi-megawatt, full data-center-scale commercial deployment, and needs a visibility platform to match its new enterprise-trust ambitions.
brief_data.the_case_p2: No F1 or Formula E grid-flexibility sponsor exists on either grid, leaving the energy-management category entirely open. As hyperscalers and utilities scrutinize Emerald's enterprise credentials, a global motorsport platform offers scale-validation no single-utility pilot can match. The slot that matches Emerald's grid-flex narrative architecturally is open at Nissan Formula E Team.

proof_points.fact: $150M oversubscribed Series A at $1.05B valuation, brings total funding to $220M+

brief_data.value_content: Emerald Conductor's real-time grid-flex and load-shedding engine maps directly onto Nissan's factory energy operations and race-weekend power draw — EV battery charging, simulator compute loads, and trackside power management all become live demonstration surfaces. Deployment surface: garage energy dashboards, factory telemetry walls, broadcast graphics showing real-time grid interaction during ePrix sessions, and pit-wall power-allocation feeds during qualifying and race format changes.
brief_data.why_team_para: Nissan Formula E Team carries no grid-flexibility or energy-management partner today, and its electrification-first positioning gives Emerald's load-shedding narrative direct thematic alignment no combustion-era team can offer. Formula E's entire proposition — cars drawing grid power, racing on street circuits embedded in urban grids — mirrors Emerald Conductor's real-time demand-response story. Nissan's global EV manufacturing scale and utility relationships give the team credibility to co-present Emerald's technology to the same hyperscaler and utility audiences it is courting.
brief_data.deal_arch_para: A three-year entry-tier grid-flexibility partnership, in the $2-4M annual range, makes Emerald the team's energy-management partner across the 2026-27 season, with activation anchored at flagship street-circuit race weekends. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font> secures renewal leverage as Emerald scales from pilot utilities toward full hyperscaler contracts.
brief_data.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  Emerald's Series A closes as Formula E teams open 2026-27 season sponsorship renewals, an 8-12 week window before grid-partner commitments lock for pre-season. No rival grid-flexibility platform has claimed the lane; a first-mover conversation now secures placement before category competitors reach the paddock.
brief_data.decision_maker_bio: Dr. Varun Sivaram founded Emerald AI in 2024 after serving as Chief Technology Officer of ReNew Power, one of India's largest renewable energy companies. He now leads Emerald's push to commercialize grid-flexible AI data-center software with utility and hyperscaler partners nationwide.
